usedFor: Shopify holds the checkouts, and Yousign receives the shopper through “Create Contact” after an “Abandoned Checkout”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Yousign
bestTemplate.why: A checkout carries an email or phone, so the contact exists in Yousign before any signing.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the contact appears after a scheduled check.
